name: Alchemist
description: You know the secrets of potions and elixirs. Start with 2 random spellbooks and a healing salve.

name: Herbalist
description: You know which plants heal and which harm. Start with healing salves and antitoxin.

name: Blacksmith
description: You forge weapons and armor. Start with a warhammer and repair tools.

name: Burglar
description: You're skilled at getting into places you shouldn't be. Start with lockpicks and a grappling hook.

name: Cleric
description: You serve a higher power. Start with a holy symbol and healing knowledge.

name: Gambler
description: You know how to read people and take risks. Start with loaded dice and extra coin.

name: Gravedigger
description: You know death intimately. Start with a shovel and knowledge of the undead.

name: Hunter
description: You track and trap game. Start with a bow and knowledge of animals.

name: Minstrel
description: You tell stories and play music. Start with an instrument and charm.

name: Mercenary
description: You fight for coin. Start with quality weapons and armor.

name: Merchant
description: You know the value of things. Start with extra coin and trade goods.

name: Outlaw
description: You live outside the law. Start with a disguise kit and a wanted poster.

name: Performer
description: You entertain crowds. Start with stage props and costumes.

name: Pickpocket
description: Your hands are quick and light. Start with stolen trinkets and lockpicks.

name: Ranger
description: You survive in the wilderness. Start with survival gear and tracking skills.

name: Rat-Catcher
description: You deal with vermin. Start with a small dog, net, and poison.

name: Scribe
description: You record knowledge. Start with writing supplies and books.

name: Smuggler
description: You move contraband. Start with hidden pockets and contacts.

name: Servant
description: You know how to serve and observe. Start with knowledge of etiquette.

name: Wizard
description: You study arcane arts. Start with 3 random spellbooks and a staff.
